recognize_zh: 頭顱側面 X 光片中顱骨整片散布多個圓形、邊緣銳利的溶骨性透亮區，呈典型「打孔狀」（punched-out）病灶，提示漿細胞腫瘤的骨骼侵犯。
features: Multiple round, sharply demarcated lucent lesions scattered throughout the calvarium
Lesions of variable size without surrounding sclerosis ('punched-out')
Skull base and facial bones without obvious large destructive lesions
describe_en: Lateral skull radiograph shows multiple round, sharply circumscribed lytic lesions of variable size throughout the calvarium, without sclerotic margins, producing a 'raindrop' or punched-out appearance. This is a radiologic image and does not provide cellular detail. The pattern is characteristic of plasma cell neoplasm involving bone; correlation with serum/urine protein studies and tissue biopsy of any associated soft tissue mass (extramedullary extension) is required.

ddx.vs: Metastases tend to be fewer and more irregular with less uniform size, and biopsy shows non-hematopoietic carcinoma cells.
LCH produces fewer, larger geographic lesions with beveled edges, typically in children, and is CD1a/langerin positive on biopsy.
Hyperparathyroid bone disease shows diffuse fine 'salt-and-pepper' mottling rather than discrete round punched-out lesions.
